message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout. I instantly went into ‘Mom mode’ and grabbed our trusty flashlights and power banks, while the kids turned it into an adventure! They started telling spooky stories in the dim light and even took charge of keeping the snacks flowing from the pantry. It reminded me that even in a little darkness, we can find a way to stay connected and cozy. Have you had a fun blackout experience with your family?
